source_title: 40 of the Best Celebrity Halloween Couples Costumes - People.com
source_excerpt:
You’ll get a scream out of the costumes cooked up by couples like Heidi Klum and Tom Kaulitz and Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker
Denise Truscello/Getty ; John Legend/Instagram
Leave it to celebrities to come up with scary good couples costumes for Halloween .
Each Halloween, they whip up detailed, un-boo-lievable recreations, paying homage to iconic TV , film and pop culture duos, from Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz to The Addams Family ’s Gomez and Morticia Addams and Grease ’s Sandy Olsson and Danny Zuko.
They’re clever, creative and instantly recognizable — think Joey Fatone and Izabel Araujo as The Shining twins in 2018 or Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker as Edward Scissorhands ’ Kim Boggs and the titular character in 2021.
Of course, Heidi Klum and her husband Tom Kaulitz have made Halloween unforgettable with their over-the-top joint costumes. At Klum’s annual Halloween party , the pair have stunned guests, dressing as everything from Shrek and Princess Fiona in 2018 to a worm and a fisherman in 2022.
“I always try to find things that people naturally wouldn’t do,” the model told PEOPLE in October 2023. “Most people do nurses or police officers, but I was always looking for something that I hadn’t seen . My goal is to not let any of my Halloween fans down.”
Here are the most iconic celebrity Halloween couples costumes.
Seal and Heidi Klum as Eve and the Forbidden Apple in 2006
Known as the “Queen of Halloween,” Klum has been one-half of her fair share of couples costumes over the years, but her stint as the Forbidden Apple to ex-husband Seal ’s Eve was truly a masterpiece, from head (Klum’s was topped off with an ominous snake) to toe (Seal even wore leaves as shoes).
Lisa Rinna and Harry Hamlin as Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz in 2010
Luuccccy, Harry’s home! At a Halloween charity event in 2010, The Traitors star Lisa Rinna and her husband Harry Hamlin were the spitting image of Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz .
Justin Mikita and Jesse Tyler Ferguson as Lloyd Christmas and Harry Dunne in 2014
Jesse Tyler Ferguson and husband Justin Mikita made quite the pair while emulating Dumb and Dumber ’s iconic Lloyd Christmas ( Jim Carrey ) and Harry Dunne ( Jeff Daniels ), rocking the characters’ famous orange and powder blue suits.
Pink and Carey Hart as Gertie and Elliot in 2015
Pink and her husband, motocross legend Carey Hart , paid homage to classic ‘80s cinema when they suited up as Gertie ( Drew Barrymore ) and Elliot ( Henry Thomas ) from the 1982 sci-fi flick E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial to match their own little alien, their then 4-year-old daughter Willow Sage .
Justin Mikita and Jesse Tyler Ferguson as Pedro and Napoleon Dynamite in 2015
Ferguson and Mikita struck costume gold again in 2015 as Napoleon Dynamite ( Jon Heder ) and Pedro (Efren Ramirez) from the 2004 comedy Napoleon Dynamite .
The Modern Family alum even capitalized on the film’s most famous lines, sharing on X , “Can you bring me my Chapstick? My lips hurt real bad.”
Eniko and Kevin Hart as Gina Waters Payne and Martin Payne in 2015
Even Kevin Hart was impressed when he and wife Eniko Hart dressed up as Martin Payne ( Martin Lawrence ) and Gina Waters Payne ( Tisha Campbell ) from the ‘90s sitcom Martin .
“#Nailedit,” he wrote on Instagram in 2015, plus six more hashtags ”in my @martinlawrence voice.”
Chance the Rapper and Kirsten Corley as Tupac and Jada Pinkett Smith in 2015
Mychal Watts/WireImage ; Chance The Rapper/X
A 1996 photograph of childhood friends Tupac Shakur and Jada Pinkett Smith inspired Chance the Rapper ’s 2015 costume with then-girlfriend Kirsten Corley .
The two emulated the ‘90s pair’s poses, with Corley wrapping her arms around Chance while wearing a similar cutout turtleneck as the Girls Trip actress and leaning her cheek against his head.
Pinkett Smith reposted the shot on Facebook in 2018, writing, “That dope a@# Halloween throwback.”
Adam Housley and Tamera Mowry as Bert and Mary Poppins in 2015
Although Tamera Mowry and Adam Housley ’s daughter Ariah Talea dressed as a character from The Incredibles in 2015, her parents also joined in on the fun by dressing as Mary Poppins and Bert from the 1964 Disney classic Mary Poppins .
Julie Andrews , who played the titular nanny , and Dick Van Dyke oughta be proud!
Beyoncé and Jay-Z as Barbie and Ken in 2016
Barbiecore wasn’t even a thing when Beyoncé and Jay-Z put their own spin on the iconic franchise with their 2016 Barbie and Ken costumes, complete with plastic boxes.
The “ Texas Hold ‘Em ” singer recreated the iconic doll’s very first look — a black-and-white striped bodysuit and a high pony — from Barbie’s debut on March 9, 1959, while her husband complemented her look in a black tux.
Kate Upton and Justin Verlander as Sandy Olsson and Danny Zuko in 2016
Kate Upton appeared to be having a blast in 2016 while showing off her moves as Grease ’s Sandy Olsson (originated by the late Olivia Newton-John ) alongside her husband, All-Star MLB pitcher Justin Verlander , dressed as Danny Zuko ( John Travolta ).
Jumping the gun on her real-life Danny’s countdown, the model can be seen laughing in a clip posted on Instagram before belting out, “You’re the one that I want!”
“Yep...@justinverlander is a better dancer than me,” Upton conceded in her caption.
Justin Timberlake and Jessica Biel as Branch and Poppy in 2016
Husband-and-wife duo Justin Timberlake and Jessica Biel got a little meta when they paid homage to the *NSYNC singer’s animated Trolls character, Branch (whom he voiced in the film), with their 2016 couples costume.
“Happy Halloween from Poppy, Branch and lil Branch,” Biel captioned their family photo on Instagram .
Lauren Miller and Seth Rogen as Luigi and Mario in 2016
Seth Rogen and wife Lauren Miller Rogen dressed up as everyone’s favorite plumber siblings and video game characters , Mario and Luigi , while attending the actor’s fifth annual Hilarity for Charity variety show at the Hollywood Palladium in L.A.
Jenna Dewan and Channing Tatum as Sally and Jack Skellington in 2017
Jenna Dewan and then-husband Channing Tatum made their daughter Everly ’s Halloween dreams come true in 2017 when they dressed up as the main characters from the 1993 stop-motion animated film The Nightmare Before Christmas .
“When your daughter asks for Sally and Jack, you give her Sally and Jack,” Dewan wrote on Instagram .
Skylar Astin and Anna Camp as Wayne Campbell and Garth Algar in 2017
One of the funniest costumes on the list comes from ex-spouses Skylar Astin and Anna Camp , who dressed as Wayne’s World ’s Wayne Campbell ( Mike Myers ) and Garth Algar ( Dana Carvey ), at Bette Midler ’s Hulaween charity event in 2017. Party on, dudes!
Darren Criss and Mia Swier as Romeo and Juliet in 2017
Mia Swier didn’t have to ask, “Wherefore art thou Romeo?” on Halloween 2017 — he was right beside her! Her husband, Glee alum Darren Criss , pulled off the young Montague with verve, crediting Nick Lang for his homemade armor and noting on Instagram , “Mia did EVERYTHING else.”
Tristan Thompson and Khloé Kardashian as Khal Drogo and Daenerys Targaryen in 2017
In 2017, then-couple Khloé Kardashian and former NBA pro Tristan Thompson capitalized on Game of Thrones ’ popularity when they shared a smooch in full Daenerys Targaryen ( Emilia Clarke ) and Khal Drogo ( Jason Momoa ) costumes.
Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade as Milli Vanilli in 2017
Gabrielle Union and her husband, retired NBA All-Star Dwyane Wade , paid homage to Milli Vanilli at the 1990 Grammy Awards by suiting up in the duo’s oversized blazers, black leggings and lace-up boots.
Union and Wade also shared a video on Instagram dancing to the lip-syncing duo’s title track from the 1989 album Girl You Know It’s True .
Joe Jonas and Sophie Turner as Gomez and Morticia Addams in 2018
Sophie Turner took her 2018 stint as Morticia Addams seriously, ruthlessly cutting the tops off a bouquet of roses as she walked alongside a cigar-holding Gomez — her then-fiancé Joe Jonas — in a black-and-white clip posted on Instagram .
Jonas got bonus points for his props, placing a floating “Thing” on his shoulder.
The Weeknd and Bella Hadid as Beetlejuice and Lydia in 2018
No, that’s not Michael Keaton and Winona Ryder — it’s The Weeknd and Bella Hadid , who made their Beetlejuice characters, the titular bio-exorcist and Lydia Deetz, proud in 2018 when they attended Klum’s Halloween bash.
Lisa Rinna and Harry Hamlin as Edie Sedgwick and Andy Warhol in 2018
Halloween buffs Rinna and Hamlin paid homage to ‘60s icons Edie Sedgwick and Andy Warhol at Rande Gerber and Cindy Crawford ‘s annual Casamigos party in 2018.
Rinna donned a cropped blonde wig, black shift dress and matching tights, while Hamlin also rocked a blonde hairpiece, as well as a pair of glasses and a camera.
Chrissy Teigen and John Legend as Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip in 2018
Chrissy Teigen and her husband, John Legend , honored Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip by dressing up as the late monarch and her longtime love in 2018.
The “All of Me” singer did it up in full-on royal regalia, while Teigen kept her look colorful in a teal overcoat with a matching hat, low-heeled pumps and a silver wig.
Neil Patrick Harris and David Burtka as Westley and Inigo Montoya in 2018
Neil Patrick Harris and his husband David Burtka are known for the epic Halloween scenes they create at home. In 2018, they brought a bit of Hollywood magic to the red carpet when they stepped out for Klum’s Halloween bash dressed as The Princess Bride ’s Westley ( Cary Elwes ) and Inigo Montoya ( Mandy Patinkin ).
Joey Fatone and Izabel Araujo as The Shining Twins in 2018
Fatone, who makes many of his family’s costumes, twinned with longtime girlfriend Araujo at the Casamigos party in 2018, holding her hand and giving off a menacing stare while wearing a frilly dress à la The Shining siblings from the 1980 horror flick.
Heidi Klum and Tom Kaulitz as Fiona and Shrek in 2018
The Halloween hostess with the mostest struck again in 2018 when she and Kaulitz transformed into Shrek and Fiona from the animated Shrek movie franchise. The look took months of planning and nine hours of makeup, as Klum later revealed to reporters, per Page Six .
Freddie Prinze Jr. and Sarah Michelle Gellar as Doc Brown and Marty McFly in 2019
Longtime couple and costars Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. took Halloween Back to the Future in 2019!
The Buffy the Vampire Slayer star sported a puffer vest and skateboard as Marty McFly ( Michael J. Fox ), while her husband rocked full, eccentric scientist gear as Doc Brown ( Christopher Lloyd ).
“Great Scott!” Gellar joked on Instagram .
Keven Undergaro and Maria Menounos as Retro McDonald’s Workers in 2019
Maria Menounos and her husband, executive producer Keven Undergaro , won major creativity points in 2019 when they showed up to the annual Casamigos Halloween party dressed as retro ‘70s McDonald’s workers.
The TV host has even posted a throwback of their costumes, revealing they made things extra official with their Halloween nosh.
“Who doesn’t love McDonald’s? Best part was going through the drive-thru late night to enjoy a meal:),” she wrote on Instagram in 2021.
Kaia Gerber and Jacob Elordi as Priscilla and Elvis Presley in 2020
Kaia Gerber and Jacob Elordi hard-launched their relationship on Instagram in 2020 with a series of photos of them dressed up as the famous ex-spouses Elvis Presley and Priscilla Presley for Halloween.
Makeup artist Sam Vissar revealed Gerber and Elordi’s inspiration, telling Vogue at the time, “Kaia had sent me the idea, as there was a specific photo of Priscilla and Elvis that they wanted to recreate.”
Hairstylist Charlie Le Mindu added, “It was more of a ‘70s Presley look instead of the ‘60s vibe.”
Though the two later called it quits , the King of Rock ‘n’ Roll seemingly made an impression on the Euphoria star, as Elordi was later cast as Elvis in the Sofia Coppola -directed 2023 biopic Priscilla .
Ashley Iaconetti and Jared Haibon as Casey Becker and Ghostface in 2020
Bachelor Nation stars-turned-spouses Ashley Iaconetti and Jared Haibon ’s 2020 costumes were a real, well, scream! Iaconetti dressed as Casey Becker ( Drew Barrymore ) in a beige sweater and a blonde bob wig from the first Scream film, while Haibon slipped into the costume of killer Ghostface.
“What’s your favorite scary movie?” he captioned their photo on Instagram .
Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker as Kim Boggs and Edward Scissorhands in 2021
While then-newlyweds Kourtney and Barker wore multiple costumes in 2021 — including one dedicated to True Romance ’s Clarence Worley ( Christian Slater ) and Alabama Whitman ( Patricia Arquette ) and a recreation of Sid Vicious and Nancy Spungen — their best ones might have been as Kim Boggs (Ryder) and the titular Edward Scissorhands ( Johnny Depp ) from Edward Scissorhands.
In a video shared on Instagram of Kourtney and the drummer all dressed up, the mother of four added a tagline from the 1990 film to her caption, writing, “ Innocence is what he knows . Beauty is what she sees.”
Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. as Frances “Baby” Houseman and Johnny Castle in 2021
Gellar and Prinze Jr. continued their Halloween hot streak in 2021 by reenacting a scene from 1987’s Dirty Dancing .
As seen in the I Know What You Did Last Summer alum’s photo shared on Instagram , she crawled toward her husband, who was dressed as Johnny Castle ( Patrick Swayze ). Gellar wore the denim capris and tied-up white blouse reminiscent of Baby’s ( Jennifer Grey ) look in the dance film as Prinze Jr. leaned back and beckoned her.
Sarah Hyland and Wells Adams as Frodo and Gandalf in 2021
Sarah Hyland and Wells Adams first sparked dating rumors on Halloween 2017 when they went Instagram official in their Stranger Things couples costume. The duo, who tied the knot in 2022, upped the ante in 2021 with their coordinated ensembles as Frodo and Gandalf from the Lord of the Rings film franchise.
“A picture with my ‘precious,’ ” the Modern Family actress jokingly wrote on Instagram .
Brendan McLoughlin and Miranda Lambert as Maverick and Charlotte “Charlie” Blackwood in 2021
Country music star Miranda Lambert and husband Brendan McLoughlin got that lovin’ feeling in 2021 when they flew through Halloween as Charlie (originally played by Kelly McGillis ) and Maverick ( Tom Cruise ) from the 1986 film Top Gun .
Heidi Klum and Tom Kaulitz as a Worm and a Fisherman in 2022
It’s not Halloween without Klum going all-out, and she was unrecognizable in her head-to-toe worm costume , complete with realistic ridges and a curved head and tail.
Kaulitz dressed as a fisherman with a hook in his eye, as shown in the creepy photo his wife shared on Instagram , and his tackle box and reel looked to be no match for the human-sized nightcrawler.
Klum teased sneak peeks of her look all day on Halloween 2022 before unveiling her full costume on the blue carpet of her famous Halloween party, which returned in person for the first time after being canceled in 2020 and 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic .
Thomas Rhett and Lauren Akins as Bowser and Donkey Kong in 2023
For Halloween 2023 in Nashville, Thomas Rhett and Lauren Akins dressed up as fan-favorite video game characters Bowser and Donkey Kong.
“Yes, Lauren is Donkey Kong 😂,” the “Die a Happy Man” singer wrote on Instagram .
Their four daughters got in on the Nintendo fun, too, with Willa Gray as Mario, Ada James as Mario, Lennon Love as Princess Peach and Lillie Carolina as Toad. (Rhett and Akins would later welcome their fifth child, son Brave Elijah , in February 2026.)
Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos in Day of the Dead costumes in 2023
Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos really bared their bones to get into the Halloween spirit at the 27th annual New York Restoration Project Hulaween gala in 2023.
For the spooky occasion, the Live with Kelly and Mark hosts appeared in matching costumes in honor of Día de Muertos (the Day of the Dead). Ripa donned a rainbow-colored ruffled dress, black leather bustier and topped off her ensemble with a rose crown. Looking just as suave, Consuelos wore a floral, black-and-gold bullfighter suit with ghoulish makeup to match his wife’s skeleton face paint.
Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber as Bamm-Bamm Rubble and Pebbles Flintstone in 2023
It might’ve been 2023, but Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber threw things back to the Stone Age with their Flintstones -inspired costumes at Vas Morgan and Michael Braun’s Halloween party in L.A.
The couple dressed up as Bamm-Bamm and Pebbles , with the “Daisies” singer going shirtless in a patterned black-and-orange bone clasp and matching hat, while the model stunned in a blue vinyl miniskirt with an orange waistband adorned with a bone and a torn-looking hemline and a patent neon green crop top with black moons. Hailey topped off her cartoon look with an orange bob wig.
Selena Gomez and Benny Blanco as Alice and the Mad Hatter in 2024
We’re all mad here! Selena Gomez and her then-boyfriend , producer Benny Blanco , went full method as Alice and the Mad Hatter .
Gomez donned a blonde wig, a black Jennifer Behr headband, a faded blue off-the-shoulder tulle dress, Sezane pumps and white socks, while Blanco appeared as the Depp version of the Mad Hatter from Tim Burton ’s 2010 movie adaptation of the novel.
“Curiouser and curiouser…,” the Only Murders in the Building actress captioned their photos on Instagram .
Hayley Kiyoko and Becca Tilley as Celia and Mike Wazowski in 2025
They only have eyes for each other! Singer Hayley Kiyoko and The Bachelor alum Becca Tilley — who got engaged in July 2025 after seven years of dating —transformed into Celia and Mike Wazowski from Monsters, Inc. for Halloween 2025.
“She said (E)YES,” Kiyoko captioned their photos on Instagram .
Taylor Lautner and Tay Lautner as Brennan Huff and Dale Doback in 2025
Taylor Lautner and his wife, Tay Lautner , took a cue from Step Brothers , dressing up as Brennan Huff ( Will Ferrell ) and Dale Doback ( John C. Reilly ).
Tay appropriately captioned their slideshow on Instagram of pose reenactments, “Did we just become best friends?”
Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively as Carl and Ellie in 2025
Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively are known for coordinating their Halloween looks, and 2025 was no exception, with the parents of four transforming into Carl and Ellie from Disney’s 2009 animated film Up .
